extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-style biographical sketch (PHS/NIH format) for senior/key personnel or significant contributors, including Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, Education/Training, and Research Support, following the provided format and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This instruction appears at the top of the form and applies to each person's biographical sketch: "Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES."

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training content and ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each training entry provide: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and FIELD OF STUDY. Start with the baccalaureate (or other initial professional education) and include subsequent postdoctoral/residency training as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative summarizing the applicant's relevant experience, expertise, and role relative to the proposed project (examples in text show mentoring role, relevant research focus, leadership responsibilities, and planned contributions to the trainee's project). Use this section to justify suitability for the role on the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment with dates (chronologic), including academic appointments and major professional roles. Also include 'Other Experience and Professional Memberships' and a separate 'Honors' list. Provide dates and brief role titles for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution to Science (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize contributions as numbered thematic areas. For each area give a short narrative of the scientific contribution and list selected relevant publications (labeled a., b., c., etc.), including citation details and PMCID/PMID when available. Optionally note equal contribution (e.g., '* The first two authors contributed equally to this paper.'). Provide a link to the complete list of published work (MyBibliography).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — Ongoing Research Support / Completed Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each support entry include grant identifier (e.g., NIH R21 AI122867), project title, funding dates, and a short description of the project's aims and relevance. Explicitly state the person's Role (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-Investigator, Trainee). Distinguish ongoing vs completed support and include project-specific responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify role on grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit 'Role:' line for each grant/support entry (examples include 'Role: Principal Investigator', 'Role: Co-Investigator', 'Role: Trainee', 'Role: Lead for the Health Economic and Impact Study Team (HEIST)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly label the individual's role on each support entry; this role statement should accompany the grant identifier, dates, and project description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date formatting for training and grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Completion Date MM/YYYY for education entries and month/day/year ranges for grants (examples: 'Completion Date MM/YYYY', '09/01/16-08/01/18').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistently format dates as shown on the form: education completion as MM/YYYY and grant/project periods as MM/DD/YY-MM/DD/YY (or MM/DD/YYYY). Include start and end dates for each support entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide full citation details and identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Citations for publications in Contributions to Science include full citation text and database identifiers (PMCID, PMID) when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When listing representative publications, include journal, year, volume/pages or article identifier, DOI when present, and PMCID/PMID if available (examples throughout the Contributions to Science).

rubrics_metrics.name: Link to complete bibliography
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: [URL]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link to the investigator's complete bibliography (MyBibliography or equivalent) so reviewers can access the full publication record in addition to the selected representative publications included in the Contributions to Science.
